description: This file defines a Fragment subclass called LogFragment that provides a UI component with a LogView for outputting log data. It handles view creation, layout configuration, and ensures the scroll view scrolls to the bottom when new log data is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView and scrolls to the bottom when logs are updated.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, and other UI properties.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the UI, sets up the TextWatcher to scroll to bottom on log updates, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
